declarations.explanation: Reviewed factory-sandbox-image against the v0.19.0 rules and the repository evidence; contextual requirements are satisfied.
evidence: .factory/Dockerfile starts from node:24-bookworm, installs pnpm@11.28.8 system-wide, and sets a writable external store as docs/development/README.md requires. Project dependencies provide TypeScript 7.0.2, oxlint 1.89.0 and Prettier 3.9.10 through pnpm install; they belong to run setup, not the image.

The Dockerfile uses no COPY, ADD, user creation, ENTRYPOINT or CMD. The factory supplies Git, GitHub CLI and agent tools. The installed babysit scripts support Node 24/26. Docker socket access is unavailable locally, so image build validation remains for hosted CI.
